mainEntity.name: What is the best type of insulation for my attic?

acceptedAnswer.text: The 'best' type of attic insulation depends on your home's specific needs, budget, and existing attic conditions. Common options include fiberglass batts or blown-in insulation, cellulose, and spray foam. Fiberglass is cost-effective and widely used. Cellulose, often made from recycled paper, offers good R-value and sound dampening. Spray foam provides excellent air sealing and a high R-value but is generally more expensive. A professional contractor can assess your attic and recommend the most suitable material to achieve optimal energy efficiency and comfort for your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: The best attic insulation type depends on your budget, needs, and attic conditions. Common choices are fiberglass, cellulose, and spray foam, each with different benefits.
